It is Republicans’ own divisions and inability to govern that has led to the longest shutdown of an agency in American history.

Tomorrow, Senate Democrats will force a fifth vote on our War Powers Resolution. 
 
Senate Republicans cannot sit on the sidelines while our servicemembers are risking their lives on the frontlines.
 
We will continue putting them on the record until the war ends or until enough of them find the courage to vote with us to end this war.

I want to express my deepest and dearest sympathies for my friend, Senator Mark Warner, his wife Lisa, and the rest of their family as they mourn the terrible loss of their daughter Madison. The depth of this loss is unfathomable.

I am keeping the Warner family in my prayers and wishing them strength. May Madison’s memory be a blessing.
